messages.text: Honestly? At month 4, shipped first product to paying customers [E-A-001]. Most of what I'm learning is hiring, prioritising, managing [ev_A_003]. My role these days: leads a team of four [ev_A_003]. That's the part of this life I think about most.

I see it differently. At month 6, finished first performance cycle [E-B-001]. Most of what I'm learning is technical leadership on projects [ev_B_003]. My role these days: senior engineer [ev_B_003]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
Fair, but from where I'm standing: What worries me most: company fails and equity goes to zero [ev_A_007]. Stress? high [ev_A_006]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
